name: report-brain-ingest
purpose: Archive every finalized weekly and monthly report in the Obsidian brain without changing canonical client truth or authorizing delivery.

steps.task: Resolve the report to one exact cadence, period, canonical client route, client-facing artifact, verification state, and canonical source path.
constraints: one exact client route per report

steps.task: Validate the report manifest, allowed source root, existing vault client note, artifact extension, date range, and idempotency key.
constraints: reject sources outside approved reporting roots
never ingest raw data exports or secret-bearing files

steps.task: Copy the report artifact into immutable brain captures and write a connected review note with canonical provenance and a SHA-256 integrity hash.
constraints: do not overwrite a different artifact

steps.task: Read back hashes, refresh maps and health, and confirm the report appears in the Report Archive and client backlinks.
constraints: do not claim Obsidian Sync without current evidence
keep routine success quiet in scheduled runs
